identitySignals: OUSD's 2021-2022 agreement title spells out NCAOSA as 'Northern California Orff-Schulwerk Association', which matches the chapter's name on ncaosa.org and aosa.org
The chapter's website describes music and movement professional development workshops for Bay Area educators, consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
AOSA's chapter directory lists the Northern California chapter with website ncaosa.org
research.notes: No registry record (ProPublica, IRS) found for this chapter; it may operate under the national association's group exemption, so no EIN is given. The agenda's Redwood City location could not be confirmed on any page, and no page mentions OUSD. The site shows only a registrar@ inbox and individual board emails, so no contact details are included.

profile.summary: The Northern California chapter of the American Orff-Schulwerk Association, founded in 1973. It offers professional development workshops in music and movement for educators and artists in the greater San Francisco Bay Area, based on the Orff Schulwerk approach to music and dance education.
